user.title: LG webOS (bscpylgtv)
user.description: Choose how to authenticate with the TV. Pairing fresh is recommended and grants full control on webOS 26 (confirmed). Use an existing client key only if you want to reuse a key you already have (e.g. from LGTVCompanion).

menu_options.fresh: Pair fresh (accept the prompt on the TV)

existing_key.title: Existing client key
existing_key.description: Enter the TV's IP and a known-good client key (for example the one extracted from LGTVCompanion's config.json).

fresh.title: Pair fresh
fresh.description: Enter the TV's IP, then watch the TV: accept the pairing prompt when it appears (you have about 30 seconds).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV. Make sure it is on and on the network.
error.manifest_rejected: The TV rejected the pairing manifest (403 blacklisted). This is a bug in the manifest replacement — please report it.
error.restricted_key: The key authenticated but was denied a core permission (401). This is a restricted/freshly-paired key — use an existing full-permission (grandfathered) key. See README sec.3a.
error.pairing_failed: Fresh pairing did not complete. Make sure you accepted the prompt on the TV, then try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not determine the TV address from discovery.

data.enable_input_switching: Enable HDMI input switching (off by default — can disturb the soundbar audio path)

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Launch an app on the TV by its app id.

app_id.name: App id
app_id.description: The webOS app id, e.g. com.webos.app.hdmi3 or netflix.

set_settings.name: Set settings
set_settings.description: Write a setSystemSettings category via the alert bridge.

category.name: Category
category.description: Settings category, e.g. picture, other, sound.

set_input.name: Set input
set_input.description: Switch the TV to a physical input.

set_sound_output.name: Set sound output
set_sound_output.description: Change the TV's audio output (external_arc, tv_speaker, bt_soundbar, ...).

command.name: Send command (raw SSAP)
command.description: Send a raw SSAP request and return the response.

uri.name: URI
uri.description: SSAP endpoint without the ssap:// prefix, e.g. audio/getVolume.

luna.name: Luna call (raw, via alert bridge)
luna.description: Fire a protected luna:// call via the createAlert/closeAlert bridge.

uri.name: URI
uri.description: Luna URI without the luna:// prefix.
